summary: The generic 2016 Stem asset-SPV umbrella should be replaced by the named Generate-Stem LCR, LLC vehicle formed in 2017. Stem's filings support a 50/50 Generate/Stem class structure, legal system-purchase/title ownership, continuing equity-method treatment and active runoff through June 2026. No Generate exit was found. Stem Finance SPV III and the broader $350 million pool are not attributable to Generate and should remain outside this record.
nonblockingDisclosureGaps: The exact Generate Class A affiliate/fund and any internal transfer are not publicly disclosed.
Historical Stem Finance SPV II mapping and legal wind-down status are unresolved.
Host/site list, deployed capacity, COD/expiry dates and the vehicle's share of aggregate SPE obligations are not separately disclosed.
